An '''optical shield''' was a type of shield that distorted visual observation. The [[Loronar Corporation/Legends|Loronar Corporation]] [[SkyBlind]] utilized optical shields in concert with [[Sensor mask (starship technology)|sensor masks]] and [[electromagnetic shield]]s.
